summary: Meta AI's Faiss vector similarity search library released version 1.14.0 with a changelog of new features, refactors, bug fixes and a header deprecation.

practices.reason: New SIMD and hardware-specific optimizations (ARM SVE, AVX512 result handlers, dynamic dispatch) could be applied to speed up vector search on our own stack, but no performance gain is quantified.
practices.quote: Add ARM SVE support for distance functions (#4798)

practices.reason: Removal of previously deprecated RAFT headers requires teams relying on that integration path to migrate before upgrading.
